steps.title: Welcome
steps.instruction: You will inspect a room the way an inspector does. This short walk-through shows you how to use the stylus, then you inspect one small room.
steps.hint: Tap Next when you are ready.

steps.title: Point at a part
steps.instruction: Hold the stylus and aim its beam at the {term:receptacle} on the wall. The part lights up when the beam is on it.
steps.hint: Move the stylus slowly until the part lights up.

steps.title: Look closer
steps.instruction: With the beam on the part, press the front button to inspect it. You see what it is and how it is installed.
steps.hint: The front button is the one nearest the tip.

steps.title: Flag a problem
steps.instruction: This part is installed wrongly. Press the front button again to flag it as a violation.
steps.hint: Look at the notes you saw when you inspected the part.

steps.title: Choose the rule
steps.instruction: Pick the rule that the part breaks. A wrong rule still counts for part of the credit if it is about the same skill.
steps.hint: Choose the entry whose title matches the problem.

steps.title: Mark a part that is fine
steps.instruction: Not everything is wrong. Aim at the {term:breaker} and press the middle button to mark it as correct.
steps.hint: The middle button is the one between the other two.

steps.title: Look up a rule
steps.instruction: Press the back button to open the rule reference, search for a word, and read an entry. Close it when you are done.
steps.hint: The back button is the one furthest from the tip.

steps.title: Finish the inspection
steps.instruction: When you have checked every part, finish the inspection to see what you found, what you missed and why it matters.
steps.hint: Use the Finish button on the panel.
